_comment: Canonical GTM sub-module map from the fellow Go-to-Market module reference. Every utopia-gtm skill belongs to exactly one sub-module. Source paths: skills/gtm/<id>/<skill>/ — ids are numbered so they never collide with skill folder names.

submodules.label: Growth Strategy
submodules.tagline: Where you are going, and why
submodules.description: Value proposition, target segments, business model, flywheels, and the GTM plan.

submodules.label: Marketing & Comms
submodules.tagline: How you share your story with the world
submodules.description: External narrative, content, social, paid, CRO, and launch communications.

submodules.label: Sales Enablement
submodules.tagline: What you equip yourself with to close
submodules.description: Collateral, discovery, qualification, deal process, and conversion assets.

submodules.label: Customer Success
submodules.tagline: How you keep and grow customers
submodules.description: Retention, expansion, renewals, sentiment, and account health.

submodules.label: BD & Partnerships
submodules.description: Outbound, signals, account tiering, warm intros, partners, and ScaleOn leverage.

submodules.label: GTM Engineering
submodules.description: RevOps, metrics, automation, agent autonomy, and pipeline systems.

submodules.label: IP Commercialisation
submodules.description: Patent strategy and commercial pathways. Operator-led today — skills land here once codified.
